title: Project Vision & Goals
structural_summary: Document uses H1 for title, H2 for major sections ('Vision Statement', 'Core Principles', 'Primary Goals', 'Project Background', 'MVP Scope Definition'), and H3 for sub-sections under 'Primary Goals'. Content is primarily descriptive text and bulleted lists.
key_structural_patterns_observed: Clear hierarchical structure using H1, H2, H3 headings.
Extensive use of bulleted lists for itemizing principles, goals, features, etc.
Well-defined thematic sections (Vision, Principles, Goals, Background, MVP Scope).
notes_for_ai_consumption: H2 and H3 headings provide excellent natural boundaries for primary and secondary content chunks. Bulleted lists under 'Primary Goals' and 'MVP Scope Definition' are well-suited for extracting specific features or objectives as individual data points. Note implicit relationships, e.g., 'Zen/Tranquility' theme connecting to 'Calm Financial Experience' principle and 'Enhanced User Experience' goal.
